# From an SLO to alert rules that actually fire

> Enter your SLO and get the error budget in minutes of downtime, multi-window multi-burn-rate alert thresholds, how fast each alert fires in an outage, and a Prometheus rules file. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
